items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Barnaby Guard asked me to tell you that he sure wishes you'd play your horn.

ctx.x: Barnaby Guard asked me to tell you that he sure wishes you'd play your horn.

Oh, yes. We'd get a little group and go to Europe, and in the words of the modernists, we could have a ball. But, no. I'm -- when you get to a certain period in life I think you should sort of sit down and let the rest of the world carry on.
